verdict.rationale: Ultrametric is a hosted process service, not an agent, so the MCP-server axis applies. It documents an official remote MCP server at https://api.ultrametric.ai/mcp, with connect instructions, OAuth scopes and a tools reference. Probes confirm the endpoint is live behind a standard RFC 9728 OAuth wall; that is expected auth gating, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of an authenticated initialize/tools/list session, and fuller documentation of the tool catalog beyond the status tool.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: In your agent host's remote MCP settings, add a connection with this server URL: https://api.ultrametric.ai/mcp
Use **MCP** when your agent supports remote tools through an MCP connection.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.ultrametric.ai/mcp/connect
the wall carries the full RFC 9728 pattern (401 + resource metadata + live well-known document)
